card.name: Turn toward what really happened
card.fires_on: The word 'actual' or 'real' before a noun, and the first word after a statement that sets up a contrast, such as But, However, If or no. It marks a turn from the hypothetical to the real outcome.

modes.label: actual/real before a noun
modes.description: The word actual or real used as an adjective meaning not hypothetical.

modes.description: The word If opening a follow-up condition after an instruction to avoid something.

card.writes: It suppresses 'actually', 'indeed' and 'actual' in several languages, so it likely lowers the chance of emphasis words on what is real.
card.plain: It fires where text turns from what might be to what actually happened or applies, mostly on words like but, however and actual.
